title: Embedding quantization sweep and operational validation
creator: Aisha Kaur
description: Objective: Define and operationalize a repeatable sweep and validation workflow for embedding model quantization profiles (INT8, FP16 and experimental FP8 variants). Deliverables include: canonical quantization profiles, automated calibration jobs, deterministic evaluation harness with similarity drift checks, rollout gating criteria for console and Dedicated, and monitoring/alerting for production drift. Motivation: previous ad-hoc calibrations produced intermittent embedding shifts; we need a reproducible, auditable pipeline and clear pass/fail criteria for deploying quantized embedding variants to production.
background: Teams currently run manual calibration for embedding variants per model which leads to inconsistent results across datasets and hardware. Root causes observed: dataset sampling variance, insufficient calibration iterations, and mismatch between calibration quantization range and runtime scaling. This ticket standardizes profiles and introduces drift-aware validation to reduce regression risk.
acceptance_criteria: Canonical quantization profiles for INT8 and FP16 (and FP8 experimental) documented and checked into repo
Automated calibration job that produces deterministic calibration artifacts given a seed and dataset snapshot
Evaluation harness that computes cosine-similarity distributions on reference datasets and flags regressions per-release
Rollout gate policy: quantized variant allowed if mean cosine similarity degradation <= 0.5% and 95th percentile degradation <= 1.5% across primary datasets
Monitoring dashboard with daily drift chart and alert when average similarity drops below gate thresholds
Runbook documenting remediation steps and rollback criteria
implementation_steps: Design canonical profile schema (scale type, per-channel vs per-tensor, clipping strategy, calibration iterations)
Instrument calibration runner to support seeds, deterministic RNG, and artifact versioning
Implement calibration sweep job that runs across representative datasets and hardware targets (A100, H100, CPU-quant emulation)
Build evaluation harness to compute cosine-sim distributions, embedding norm shifts, and downstream retrieval NDCG delta
Define gating thresholds and integrate checks into CI and deployment pipeline
Add metrics to Console: per-model similarity delta, rolling mean, and alerting rules
Create runbook with triage checklist and rollback playbook
tests: Integration: calibration runner produces identical artifact given same seed across two runs
Evaluation: similarity distribution comparison runner reproduces baseline numbers on staging
Canary: deploy quantized variant to 1% traffic and verify no similarity regression > gate for 48h
validation_plan: Primary validation uses three curated datasets: internal-retrieval-small, semantic-search-benchmark, and multilingual-sample. For each dataset run: baseline floating-point embedding run -> quantized embedding run -> compute paired cosine similarities. Produce per-query metrics (mean, median, std, 90/95 percentiles) and a distribution plot. Flag candidate if mean similarity drops by more than 0.5% or if 95th percentile drops by more than 1.5%. Secondary checks: embedding L2 norm shift > 2% triggers investigation; downstream retrieval NDCG drop > 0.75% blocks rollout.
monitoring_and_alerts: Instrument telemetry: per-request baseline_cosine, quantized_cosine, norm_delta. Expose aggregated metrics: avg_cosine_delta_24h, p95_cosine_delta_24h, avg_norm_delta_24h. Alert when avg_cosine_delta_24h < -0.005 or p95_cosine_delta_24h < -0.015. Pager escalation: SRE on-call -> model infra -> PM if incident persists > 3h.
calibration_artifacts: Each calibration run must produce: profile.json (schema v1), histogram dumps, RNG seed, dataset snapshot hash, and a reproducible calibration binary artifact. Artifacts are versioned and stored in gs://redwood-embed-calibrations/YYYYMMDD/<model>/<profile-id>/.
rollout_policy: Quantized variants are deployed behind rollout policies that perform: ci-gate (automated similarity tests), canary (1% traffic for 48h with telemetry validation), staged rollout to 10/25/50/100% with 24-48h holds and automated similarity checks at each stage. Automatic rollback if any gate triggers.
risk_and_mitigation: Risk: dataset skew producing optimistic calibration. Mitigation: use multiple dataset slices including adversarial hard examples. Risk: hardware-specific behavior (FP8 emulation mismatch). Mitigation: include hardware matrix in sweep and conservatively only promote profiles that pass on target hardware.
